> 2026-10-18 amendment: the built-in loop is Python, not Rust. Branch data and > evidence persist through the existing session/UI; Python constructs model > context. Hosted completion requires a current accepted changeset and reports > runtime checks unrun. Old Rust-runtime evidence below is historical. See > [the migration audit](../audits/2026-10-18-python-agent-ownership.md).

The additive shared-controller and captured-owner behavior, focused check results, source fingerprints and remaining gaps are recorded in [the scoped reading-surface contract](../agent/scoped-reading-surfaces-share-native-actions.md). Earlier verification above is historical; it does not establish current universal UI parity or native/provider/release acceptance.

| | Where it lives | The change of mind is | |---|---|---| | **Rewind** | one session file, one conversation, an abandoned branch in the tree | **kept** — visible in the file forever | | **Re-run** | a second session file; the first is a draft you may discard | **not kept** — nothing in session 2 refers to session 1 |

The shipped embedding host controls and actual graph/image editors share the parent scoped broker. Recorded-profile import validates bounded schema/source integrity and keeps pin/remove local to the page. It does not execute, authenticate or certify a run. Markdown navigation is supplied by the installed editor extension and binds current source/path; skipped code cannot be navigated. Browser/shell open results report requests, not loaded destinations. Review copy uses the native clipboard handler and returns requires_input on denial. The file-menu clipboard fallback refuses a false browser copy result.

Generated markdown image navigation shares its native generating-block callback, bound to the current prose image/path. A path-only transaction refreshes its image widget target. Historical commit-context loads bind the selected commit and refuse late replacement results. A failed context load remains retryable. Generated buffer Retry/Discard shares the current ordinary saver/entry/source/baseline; failed saves retain drafts and stale discards cannot discard newer bytes. Actual save results and possible late effects remain explicit, with no verification claim.

LLM implementation review: partially verified for these paths. Universal parity and current provider/package/release acceptance remain incomplete.

The actual prompt draft is read/editable through shared actions. Dired owns that draft and its operation identity; parent submission displays its actual destination while pending. Native typing invalidates old parent handles. Agent confirmation requires explicit true. Synchronous owner/admission checks refuse stale callbacks, duplicate submissions and prompt replacement/cancellation while the operation is pending, including before React paints. A refused operation is not a success. Partial multi-path failure retains the completed paths, refreshes the tree and never guesses rollback; the failed prompt remains available for inspection.

LLM implementation review: partially verified for these paths. Eight focused prompt/dired cases and the existing native delete-confirmation case passed; targeted TypeScript passed. Host filesystem operations are injected, so this is not a current native-platform witness. Dependencies, assumptions and remaining issue-72 work are in the active handoff. Human judgment is not supplied.

Host-supplied DocumentEmbed previews and PicturePanel share bounded explicit capture of actual browser-loaded pixels. Capture binds the current image owner, source/path and load epoch; retirement/abort cannot deliver the old raster as a replacement view. Browser CORS/secure-context refusal is requires_input, with no security bypass. Host image failures do not claim a missing cell recording. Pixel capture is not original-file equality or program execution evidence.

LLM implementation review: partial. Two focused owner/CORS component cases and two actual Chrome parent-bridge PNG/digest flows passed, with no engine requests. Targeted strict TypeScript passed. Exact hashes, failed fixture corrections and remaining package/provider/publication acceptance are in the issue-72 handoff. Human judgment is not supplied. The separately building native checkpoint does not include this later slice and cannot witness it.

Requirement: issue 72/#74 requires actual shared OS controls or an explicit tracked OS limitation, and #77 retains a human-owned End/quarantine boundary. The native Window menu and UI registry now invoke the same current-window minimize/restore controller. Explicit status reads return host-observed platform and minimized state only. No caller selects another window, file or arbitrary IPC. Browser/missing callbacks return a required-input result; uncertain host failures are not successful closure/minimization claims. Predefined macOS About, Services, Hide, Hide Others and Show All remain a tracked #74 platform limitation, with an addressable operation request and retained pending result. Human conversation reports are not authenticated OS completion. macOS execution is unavailable on this Linux host and must be qualified separately.

Review discovered that the private page bypasses App's close listener. It now shares a close controller between the native event, ended-page button and registry. An agent cannot end/close its own quarantine. Human close before End is refused. After durable End, local host close bypasses the retired project router/receipt lease; it does not reopen project capabilities. The human button/event call the same controller directly because persisting an action receipt through an expired project lease would prevent closing. An agent-visible close request still returns requires_input. Host acknowledgment does not prove window destruction.

LLM implementation review: partial, covering the finite callbacks, origin/body validation, ended-only local close and retired-router independence. Assumption: the current native host owns the one main window; SDK state is a point-in-time report and OS scheduling can change it immediately. Falsifiers include a foreign origin closing a window, active quarantine closing, arbitrary target parameters, a late receipt preventing human close, or a held-out field entering window output. Executed checks: 12 focused frontend cases (window responses, OS requests, private coach), 7 existing bridge cases, one real local proxy/Connection lifecycle test; CLI and native desktop cargo check and targeted strict TypeScript passed. The first frontend invocation used the repository root and lacked jsdom; rerunning from apps/web passed. The first standalone TypeScript command omitted dom.iterable; including that configured DOM library passed. No broad regression was run. Human judgment: not supplied. These checks do not establish paid-provider, reviewed footage/publication, deployed or other-platform acceptance.

Thirteen focused frontend cases and targeted strict TypeScript passed after the fix. The 49a2a491 package build precedes this final recovery fix and cannot attest it. The scripted ACP witness above also precedes this recovery-only change; its execution/gate paths are unchanged. LLM review remains partial; human judgment remains absent.
